noise.rule: a difference is 'detectable' only if the two IQRs do not overlap AND the relative median difference exceeds the A/A floor (95th percentile, across cells, of the relative median difference between two identical graph_total callables)

note: machine-dependent wall-clock timings; inputs are seeded and deterministic; not byte-stable

settings.warmup_rule: min(warmup_max, 0.5 s / one call), at least 2
